title: Aqua: Network-Accelerated Memory Offloading for LLMs in Scale-Up GPU Domains
problem: LLM inference under bursty request patterns exhausts GPU memory, causing serving engines to use admission control that renders them unresponsive; preemptive time-sliced scheduling requires KV-cache paging that incurs high overhead and reduces throughput.
motivation: Cloud-hosted LLM serving must remain responsive under bursty demand while sustaining high throughput, but current GPU memory management cannot reconcile both goals simultaneously.
method: Aqua is a GPU memory management framework that uses the high-bandwidth scale-up network (NVLink/NVSwitch fabric within a server) as a fast memory offloading path for paging LLM inference state (KV caches). When a prompt is preempted, Aqua pages its KV cache over the scale-up network to remote GPU memory on other nodes rather than to slow host DRAM or NVMe, dramatically reducing paging latency. A scheduling layer enables preemptive time-sliced prompt execution on top of this low-overhead paging mechanism.
key_novelty: Using the intra-server scale-up GPU interconnect (NVLink fabric) as a fast KV-cache paging path to enable low-overhead preemptive LLM scheduling without throughput loss.
contributions: Identification that scale-up network bandwidth can be repurposed for fast GPU memory offloading
Aqua GPU memory management framework enabling preemptive time-sliced LLM inference
20x improvement in responsiveness and 4x throughput improvement over state-of-the-art for bursty LLM workloads

metrics.speedup: 4x throughput improvement over single long prompt baseline; 20x responsiveness improvement vs state-of-the-art
metrics.other: evaluated on 8x NVIDIA H100 80GB GPU server

baselines: state-of-the-art LLM serving engines with admission control
limitations: Requires scale-up network (NVLink/NVSwitch) which is only available in high-end multi-GPU server configurations; not applicable to scale-out or single-GPU deployments.
primary_theme: network-accelerated KV-cache paging for responsive LLM serving
